sourceEnglish.title: Checkout Walkthrough: Breakfast Feedback to the Manager
sourceEnglish.objective: Review the stay's breakfasts with the manager, give balanced feedback, and agree on conditions for returning.
sourceEnglish.speaking: You are checking out of apartment 7B, and the AI is Gonzalo, the apart-hotel manager: review the stay's breakfasts, give balanced feedback, and set conditions for returning with volvería siempre que…, sería ideal que… and the conditional.
englishWordAnchors: Overall, we loved the breakfast, especially the seasonal fruit.
The only thing I'd improve is the variety of celiac-safe options.
We'd come back as long as there's gluten-free bread every day.
It would be ideal if you restocked the fruit more often in the morning.
If you gave us 7B again, we'd gladly book.
We'd come back in March provided the rate is similar.
Gonzalo, I'll gladly leave you a good review on the platform.
Kids, what did you like most about the breakfast?
englishGrammarExamples: I'd come back as long as there's gluten-free bread at breakfast.
It would be ideal if the butter came in individual portions.
englishReading: On Sunday at 10, Laura hands in the key to apartment 7B at the front desk of the apart-hotel in Pocitos.
Gonzalo, the manager, asks her how the stay went and what it would take for the family to book again.
Laura: Overall, we loved the breakfast, especially the seasonal fruit.
Laura: Kids, what did you like most about the breakfast?
Sofía says the homemade granola was the strong point, because she ate it every morning with yogurt.
Gonzalo asks whether anyone in the family has an allergy or a dietary restriction.
Laura explains that Tomás is celiac and can only eat products that are safe for celiacs.
Laura: The only thing I'd improve is the variety of celiac-safe options.
She says the gluten-free selection was good on Monday, but on Wednesday there were only crackers left.
Laura: We'd come back as long as there's gluten-free bread every day.
Another weak point was the butter, because it came in a shared tub and Tomás couldn't use it without a risk of cross-contamination.
Laura: It would be ideal if the butter came in individual portions.
Gonzalo writes down the feedback and says he is going to talk to the kitchen this week.
Gonzalo: For your next visit, we have a special offer with a 15% discount on stays of 5 nights or more.
Laura: We'd come back in March provided the rate is similar.
Laura: If you gave us 7B again, we'd gladly book.
Gonzalo asks what score she would give the breakfast, and Laura answers that she would give it a 9 out of 10.
Laura: Gonzalo, I'll gladly leave you a good review on the platform.

lessons.title: Give balanced breakfast feedback at checkout
lessons.objective: Review the family's breakfasts with the lodging manager, name strengths and concerns, and explain what verified options would matter for a future stay.
lessons.focus: 全体として and 一方で balance praise and concern; 次回は～を確認できれば frames a condition for returning. セリアック病, グルテンフリー and 混入 name the source's clinical and food-handling concepts directly.
lessons.scene: At checkout, a family discusses breakfast quality and celiac-disease accommodation with a guesthouse manager.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.ja: 朝食とご滞在はいかがでしたか。
reader.en: How were the breakfasts and your stay?

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 全体として満足しました。特に季節の果物がよかったです。
reader.en: Overall, we were pleased. We especially liked the seasonal fruit.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.ja: 改善してほしい点はありますか。
reader.en: Is there anything you would like us to improve?

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 家族にセリアック病の者がいます。表示だけでなく、原材料と調理方法を確認したいです。
reader.en: Someone in our family has celiac disease. We need to check ingredients and preparation, not just a label.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 共用のバターの容器も、混入が心配で使えませんでした。
reader.en: We also could not use the shared butter container because of cross-contact concerns.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.ja: ご意見を記録し、厨房の手順を確認します。
reader.en: I will record your feedback and check the kitchen's procedure.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 次回は、選べる食品の情報を事前に確認できれば助かります。
reader.en: For a future visit, it would help to check available food information in advance.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.ja: 予約前にお問い合わせください。確認できた内容をお伝えします。
reader.en: Please contact us before booking. We will tell you what we can verify.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: ありがとうございます。料金と部屋の条件も確認してから検討します。
reader.en: Thank you. We will consider it after checking the rate and room terms too.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.ja: 具体的な感想をありがとうございました。
reader.en: Thank you for the specific feedback.

speaking.opening: 朝食は全体としてよかったです。よかった点と、次回確認したい点をお伝えしてもいいですか。
speaking.goal: Praise one concrete feature, explain a celiac cross-contact concern, ask how food information could be verified before a future booking, and check rate terms.
speaking.closure: Summarize the breakfast feedback and conditions for a future booking.

sourceEnglish.title: Capstone: A Group Breakfast in Puebla Goes Sideways
sourceEnglish.objective: Lead a group through a hard breakfast morning: teach, solve, refuse, report, message and close it out in Spanish.
sourceEnglish.speaking: You are leading five relatives through a Puebla breakfast, and the AI is Emilio, server Brenda, the host and the manager: coach Emilio's order, check tía Rosa's allergens, order for all, text the host and give checkout feedback, using commands, conditionals and the subjunctive.
englishWordAnchors: Emilio, say hello first and then you order, no rush.
Excuse me, Brenda, could you bring us the allergen binder?
Auntie, don't order anything until we confirm the ingredients.
If the mole is sold out, what do you recommend instead?
Thank you, Brenda, but without seeing the ingredients we won't risk it.
I'm letting you know the allergen binder was missing today.
Hi, I'm writing because we're going to arrive 20 minutes late.
We'd come back as long as the allergen binder is on display.
englishGrammarExamples: You ask Brenda, and if she doesn't know, have her check with the kitchen.
If we hadn't checked the binder, my aunt would have ordered the pipián.
englishReading: On Sunday, Daniel takes five relatives to have breakfast at the Hotel Azulejo, in Puebla, before visiting Café Cholula.
His nephew Emilio wants to practice Spanish, so Daniel tells him: Emilio, say hello first and then you order, no rush.
Emilio orders the chalupas and a champurrado, and the cook makes them on the griddle next to the counter.
Daniel looks for the allergen binder for his aunt Rosa, who is allergic to peanuts, but it isn't on the table.
Daniel: Excuse me, Brenda, could you bring us the allergen binder?
Brenda looks at the entrance, but she comes back without it because nobody can find it today.
Daniel: Auntie, don't order anything until we confirm the ingredients.
Aunt Rosa wanted the mole poblano, but Brenda explains that it is sold out today.
Daniel: If the mole is sold out, what do you recommend instead?
Brenda offers the pipián as a substitute, but she doesn't know if the sauce contains peanuts.
Daniel: Thank you, Brenda, but without seeing the ingredients we won't risk it.
Brenda asks in the kitchen and confirms that the pipián does contain peanuts, but the enfrijoladas don't.
Emilio: If we hadn't waited, aunt Rosa would have ordered the pipián.
Daniel places the order for the six of them and orders the enfrijoladas for aunt Rosa with a note about her allergy.
The cousins order the potato molotes, and uncle Javier prefers the breaded steak cemitas to go.
After breakfast, Daniel writes to Lupita, the café's host: Hi, I'm writing because we're going to arrive 20 minutes late.
When he hands in the keys, Daniel tells the hotel manager: I'm letting you know the allergen binder was missing today.
The manager asks him to fill out the satisfaction survey, and Daniel writes: We'd come back as long as the allergen binder is on display.

lessons.title: Lead a group through a difficult breakfast
lessons.objective: Coach a relative's order, seek allergen information for another relative, handle an unavailable dish, update the next host about a delay, and give measured checkout feedback in Japanese.
lessons.focus: まず・次に・最後に organize the capstone; ～なら asks about a substitute; 確認できないので注文しません explains a refusal. ピーナッツアレルギー, 原材料 and 調理方法 carry the source's specific food vocabulary.
lessons.scene: A family breakfast group handles a missing allergen binder, a sold-out dish and a delayed next appointment before checkout.

reader.speaker: Leader
reader.ja: まず、ゆっくりあいさつして、食べたい物を伝えてみて。
reader.en: First, greet the staff and say what you would like, without rushing.

reader.speaker: Relative
reader.ja: おはようございます。朝食のセットを一つお願いします。
reader.en: Good morning. One breakfast set, please.

reader.speaker: Leader
reader.ja: 別の親戚にはピーナッツのアレルギーがあります。資料と調理方法を確認できますか。
reader.en: Another relative has a peanut allergy. Could we check the information and preparation method?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.ja: 資料が見つからず、最初に希望された料理も品切れです。
reader.en: We cannot find the information, and the dish you first wanted is sold out too.

reader.speaker: Leader
reader.ja: 代わりの料理の原材料と調理方法を確認していただけますか。
reader.en: Could you check the substitute dish's ingredients and preparation?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.ja: 厨房に聞きましたが、混入の可能性までは確認できません。
reader.en: I asked the kitchen, but we cannot verify the cross-contact risk.

reader.speaker: Leader
reader.ja: 分かりました。確認できないので、本人は今は注文を見送ります。
reader.en: Understood. Because it cannot be verified, the affected person will hold off on ordering for now.

reader.speaker: Affected relative
reader.ja: ありがとう。自分の予定と必要なことは私が決めます。
reader.en: Thank you. I will decide my own next steps and needs.

reader.speaker: Leader
reader.ja: 次の宿の方に、到着が遅れると連絡します。
reader.en: I will tell the next lodging host that we will arrive late.

reader.speaker: Leader
reader.ja: 最後に、資料が見つからなかったことを会計時に事実として伝えます。
reader.en: Finally, I will report at checkout that the information could not be found, as a matter of fact.

speaking.partnerRole: Relative, server, next lodging host and manager
speaking.opening: まず注文を確認します。その後、アレルゲンの情報について質問したいです。
speaking.goal: Coach one relative, request current ingredients and preparation for another, decline unverified food, notify the next host of a delay, and give factual checkout feedback.
speaking.closure: Summarize the group's order, the delayed arrival message and the checkout feedback.
